description: This file contains JavaScript functions related to rendering user and organization options, as well as filtering user and organization data based on DOM elements and provided data structures.

methods.name: renderUserOrgOption
methods.description: Generates display options for user or organization data, returning an array with formatted string and name.

methods.name: filterUserOrg
methods.description: Filters out users and organizations from data based on current DOM elements and sorts the remaining data by display name.
